resources.string:
AUTHORIZED TESTING ONLY — document client approval before any engagement.
FLIPPER + AWOK • USB: 115200 8N1, DTR/RTS on. Open Pen15 Controller FAP before heavy use. • AWOK on GPIO: use Wi‑Fi / Marauder cards; AWOK USB chip is a separate path.
FLIPPER CLI (FAP / JSON path in app) • RFID read: rfid read • NFC: use on-device UI; field: nfc field on|off • SubGHz RX: subghz rx <freq_hz> • IR RX: ir rx • Storage: storage list /ext/
MARAUDER (AWOK UART) • scanap — list APs • stopscan — stop scan • select -a <n> — pick row • attack -t deauth — lab only, written consent • sniffpmkid — capture lab hashes
TERMUX / OSINT • Install from F-Droid; allow-external-apps in ~/.termux/termux.properties • Files permission: Settings → Apps → Termux → Files and media → Allow • pkg install curl python (minimal for OSINT scripts in PEN15)
GOOGLE DORKS • Use Builder tab; open in browser; respect robots + law. • Prefer scoped site: queries on assets you are allowed to assess.
ANDROID • Logcat tags: FlipperUSBManager, FapProtocol, FlipperGPIOBridge for USB issues. • Export logs from app storage under recon / captures paths where applicable.
